Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk has claimed that he has been placed under house arrest in Ladakh, with security personnel deployed outside his residence. The administration has imposed 60-day restrictions on his movement under Section 163 of the BNSS ahead of the LAHDC elections. Here’s what led to the action and why Ladakh’s local groups are protesting.
